message:
Command `bash /workspace/build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src/test && git checkout fuzz.c && python3 -c "
with open(\"fuzz.c\", \"r\") as f:
    content = f.read()
old = \"while ((ofs = mg_mqtt_next_prop(&mm, &prop, ofs)) > 0) {\"
new = \"fprintf(stderr, \\\"DEBUG: mm.dgram.buf=%p mm.dgram.len=%zu props_start=%zu props_size=%zu\\\\n\\\", mm.dgram.buf, mm.dgram.len, mm.props_start, mm.props_size);\\n      while ((ofs = mg_mqtt_next_prop(&mm, &prop, ofs)) > 0) {\"
content = content.replace(old, new)
with open(\"fuzz.c\", \"w\") as f:
    f.write(content)
print(\"Modified\")
" && cc fuzz.c -DMAIN -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMG_ENABLE_SOCKET=0 -DMG_ENABLE_LOG=0 -DMG_ENABLE_LINES=1 -DMG_ENABLE_TCPIP=1 -I. -o /tmp/fuzzer_dbg6 2>&1 | tail -5 && objdump -d /tmp/fuzzer_dbg6 | sed -n "/<mg_mqtt_next_prop>:/,/^$/p" | head -80'` executed with exit code 0.
